When Anthropic release a new model it's always worth taking a look at their updated prompting guide - here's an entertaining tip to make Fable 5.2 less likely to be cautious in how it improves existing code: tell it "This codebase is yours" https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-engineering/prompting-claude-fable-5-2#say-who-owns-the-code
Something I enjoy about these prompting guides is that it's VERY clear from reading them that Anthropic are just as surprised by the idiosyncrasies of their new models as we are
